notes.title: Update notes for 7/30/2025
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Tomba! Special Edition. The latest patch is live and makes the following changes.

[list]
[*] Adds Japanese language support.
[*] Audio performance improvements.
[*] General performance improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
[Steam] Remastered Music now starts correctly when new areas/sections are loaded.
[Steam] Fixed issue with Mermaid Singing Rock remastered music.
[Steam] Fixed issue with Purified Haunted Mansion remastered music.
[Steam] Fixed issue with Purified Phoenix Nest remastered music.
[Steam] Fixed a possible softlock during Game Over.
[Steam] Add datestamp display for save games.
[Steam] Better USB controller enumeration on startup
[Steam] Fix issue with unicode save paths

notes.title: Tomba! Launches Today!
notes.notes: Wishlisters, rejoice! Tomba! Special Edition is now live and ready to play on Steam. Hop in right now, pick it up, and embark on a spellbinding journey of retro rediscovery as Tomba takes on the evil pigs in a timeless non-linear adventure.

notes.title: Tomba! Special Edition Lands on Steam This Week
notes.notes:
Hi all! A reminder that Tomba! Special Edition launches on Steam THIS THURSDAY! You'll be able to pick it up August 1 for $19.99 USD. It's the same Tomba! you know and love, plus enhanced features including save states, rewind, documentary content, and more. 

To all of you who have already wishlisted, we're extremely grateful. And if you haven't yet, now's the time!

See you later this week!
